Lemma
[Multiplication identity] \group lobachevsky Source: thurston:page-0172, thurston:page-0173

For every nonzero integer $n$, \[ \Lambda (n\theta )=n\sum _{j\bmod |n|}\Lambda (\theta +j\pi /n). \] In particular, $\frac12\Lambda (2\theta )=\Lambda (\theta )+\Lambda (\theta +\pi /2)$ and $\frac32\Lambda (\pi /3)=\Lambda (\pi /6)$.
Proof

\sketch Factor $2\sin (nu)$ into the shifted factors $2\sin (u+j\pi /n)$, integrate logarithms, and use oddness and periodicity to extend from positive $n$ to all nonzero integers.

□
